ESDOCS EMEA LIMITED.event: Acquired by Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) and rebranded to ICE Digital Trade
ESDOCS EMEA LIMITED.evidence: Official corporate blog and registrar filings show that the company was acquired by Intercontinental Exchange in 2022 and rebranded to ICE Digital Trade, providing paperless trade finance software solutions.

Taulia LLC.evidence: Taulia LLC was acquired by SAP in 2022 and officially rebranded to SAP Taulia in July 2025 according to the company's official press releases. It provides supply chain finance and accounts receivable finance solutions as verified on its official website.
